finding.summary: PR #1540 binds evidence records to a shared caller-supplied claim_id, but that identifier was opaque and was not required to fingerprint the claim text. Different propositions could therefore be assigned the same claim_id.

correction.algorithm: SHA-256 over a versioned namespace and NFKC-normalized, case-folded, whitespace-collapsed claim text
correction.punctuation: Preserved; wording changes produce a different fingerprint
correction.enforcement: Every evidence record named in CORROBORATED or CONTRADICTORY results must have claim_id equal to the canonical fingerprint of its own claim text.
correction.adapter: MMIExistingSystemsAdapter.evidence_record now generates the fingerprint by default and rejects a caller-supplied mismatch.

tests_added: Different wording produces different claim fingerprints
A corroboration result cannot reuse one opaque caller-selected ID across unrelated propositions
The adapter generates the canonical ID
The adapter rejects a forged or mismatched ID
limitations: A cryptographic fingerprint binds the exact normalized text; it does not prove semantic truth.
It does not establish that distinct publishers have independent reporting lineage.
Common-origin lineage_id/origin_source_id and reviewed publisher-alias maintenance remain future work.
